metadata.description: Discipline kits for Claude Code. Install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: code-kit
plugins.description: Plan → Confirm → Implement → Verify discipline for software work: hooks, skills, review agents and a CLAUDE.md ruleset.

plugins.name: design-kit
plugins.description: Brief → Direction → Build → Audit for interface work: a DESIGN_MAP.md direction file, slop and motion hooks, design skills and review agents.

plugins.name: research-kit
plugins.description: Question → Evidence → Draft → Verify → Cite discipline for scholarly writing in LaTeX and BibTeX, with citation enforcement.

plugins.name: marketing-kit
plugins.description: Research → Position → Create → Gate → Measure for marketing your own product: a MARKETING_MAP.md evidence file, hooks that block unsourced social proof and gate publishing, skills and review agents.
